'''Balanced islands''' are Catanova's current map preset. Every island has 19 land hexes arranged in rows of 3, 4, 5, 4, and 3, with nine [[Trading and ports|ports]]. The goal is useful variety without making every starting spot equal.

{| class="wikitable"
! Terrain !! Hexes
|-
| Forest || 4
|-
| Hills || 3
|-
| Pasture || 4
|-
| Fields || 4
|-
| Mountains || 3
|-
| Desert || 1
|}

== What the generator avoids ==
* More than two connected hexes of the same resource.
* A resource being entirely confined to one small area: each type has at least two hexes separated by three or more hex steps.
* A 6 or 8 touching another 6 or 8.
* An intersection exceeding eleven production dots across its adjacent hexes.
* Resource types with average production outside the preset's range of 2.5–4 dots per hex. The lower total is rounded up when a type has three hexes.

The four general ports and five specialized ports are shuffled independently over nine separated coastal edges. A corner can still touch three different resources, and some locations remain stronger than others. The [[Getting started|reverse second placement]] matters; this preset does not guarantee equal outcomes or equal seats.

== What are production dots? ==
{| class="wikitable"
! Dice total !! Ways to roll it !! Dots
|-
| 2 or 12 || 1 out of 36 || 1
|-
| 3 or 11 || 2 out of 36 || 2
|-
| 4 or 10 || 3 out of 36 || 3
|-
| 5 or 9 || 4 out of 36 || 4
|-
| 6 or 8 || 5 out of 36 || 5
|}

Dots describe probability, not a production schedule. The map seed reproduces the island, but does not determine dice rolls, robber thefts, or the development deck. There is no forced dice balancing or catch-up production bonus.

== Preset status ==
This is a Catanova preset, separate from the official spiral-number setup or fixed beginner board. Those reference setups are documented but are not currently selectable in the app. See the [https://github.com/shashwtd/catanova/blob/main/docs/MAP_GENERATION.md generator specification] for exact constraints.
